She has two difficulties depending on her summoning method. Her weaker form has {{HP|20,000}}, and can be summoned with 4 [[Arachne's Calling]]s, similar to [[Ender Dragon|dragon fights]]. She also can be summoned with one [[Arachne Crystal]], spawning a stronger version with {{HP|100k}}. Arachne can summon [[Arachne's Brood]]s, which have {{Hp|4,000}}, or {{HP|20,000}}. Defeating Lesser and Greater Version of Arachne for the first time rewards {{SkyBlock XP}}. == Summoning == '''Arachne''' can be summoned in the {{Zone|Arachne's Sanctuary}} on the altar in the middle of the room. Placing four {{Item|Arachne's Calling}}s will spawn the weaker version, whereas placing one {{Item|Arachne Crystal}} will spawn the stronger version. After placing the four fragments or the crystal, the spider will spawn after a short delay, and displaying a line of dialogue explaining how much of a mistake the players have made. == Variants == {{Mob Variants |level = 87 |spawn_location = [[Arachne's Sanctuary]] (4 [[Arachne's Calling]]s) |health = 20,000 |damage = 300 |coins = 217 |combat_xp = 652 |orbs = 261 |id = ARACHNE_300 |level2 = 143 |spawn_location2 = [[Arachne's Sanctuary]] (1 [[Arachne Crystal]]) |health2 = 100,000 |damage2 = 600 |coins2 = 357 |combat_xp2 = 1,072 |orbs2 = 429 |id2 = ARACHNE_500 }} == Behavior == After it spawns, Arachne will run around, damaging players around it. It is recommended to use an [[Aspect of the End]] to escape upon noticing your hindered movement. The player needs to be at least {{skl|Combat}} level 15 to fight a Tier 2 Arachne. Arachne has a damage cap of 1,000 per hit. Upon dropping below {{Green|50%}} and {{Green|20%}} {{Stat|hp}}, Arachne splits into a number of [[Arachne's Brood]]s (10 for {{Green|50%}} and 20 for {{Green|20%}}). These spiders, like Arachne, are immune to magic damage and arrows. Once all of the brood are killed Arachne will respawn. Arachne has a chance to respawn as a [[Runecrafting#Runic Mobs|Runic variant]]. If Arachne has not damaged a player within roughly 6 seconds, she will use Venom Shot on whoever she is currently targeting. This debuff poisons players, lowering them to ~1% of their maximum health every few seconds. A [[Cow Hat]] can nullify the effect. This does not affect shields/absorption (i.e. a [[Necron's Blade]] Variant's [[Necron's Blade Scrolls|Wither Impact]]/[[Necron's Blade Scrolls|Wither Shield]]). To counter this, using Wither Impact/Wither Shield about 1 second after taking a Venom Shot will allow you to regenerate health (i.e. with [[Enchantments|Life Steal]]) while your shield is active. If you do not have access to a variant of the [[Necron's Blade]], it is recommended to disable [[Potions|Dodge]]/[[Potions|Agility]] potions to allow Arachne to damage you, which means she won't use Venom Shot. Sometimes Arachne will 'refuse' to hurt you (likely a bug). It should also be noted that the [[Vaccine Talisman]], [[Vaccine Ring]] and [[Vaccine Artifact]] do not protect the person inflicted with the venom shot debuff from getting poisoned. Additionally, the venom effect does ''not'' expire on death, meaning on your way back to the boss room you are still at risk of dying to spiders along the way. The rest will spawn on the next "floor" up. In order to get the rest of the loot, you will have to travel directly upwards. It is most commonly located above ground. **Loot from this boss can spawn one or two blocks above the void as well. == Trivia == * '''[[W:Arachne|Arachne]]''' is a character from Greek and Roman mythology. According to the Ovid's version of the myth; human woman and a talented weaver, Arachne, claimed that her skill was greater than the one of Minerva (Roman version of Athena. Both goddesses have weaving as part of their divine domain.), without acknowledging that her skill, at least partially, came from the goddess. Disguised as an old lady, the goddess warned Arachne not to boast and compare oneself to a god, and that she should ask for the goddess' forgiveness. A weaving competition ensued, with the goddess weaving a tapestry, displaying different myths of gods competing against humans and them being punished for it, while Arachne displayed stories of gods misleading, abusing, tricking and seducing mortals. The goddess was enraged by this depiction and the fact it was better than her own, so she destroyed the work and hit Arachne thrice in the head with a shuttle. Embarrassed by this, Arachne tried to hang herself, but the goddess took pity on her and turned her into a spider, so that she, and her descendants could weave freely. **"Arachne" or Αράχνη is also the Ancient Greek word for spider. * The [[Livid Dagger|Livid Dagger's]] 2x Damage from backstab bypasses the damage cap. * {{stat|fero}} is '''not''' useful against Arachne as it has a damage cap. (It still triggers the animation and sound of {{stat|fero}}) * In each phase, Arachne has chance to be Runic, this doesn't necessarily last the whole fight, as after next Brood phase she again has chance to be runic. * The {{Item|Arachne Shard}} drop in the boss loot is not affected by {{stat|hunting fortune}}, however it is also possible to obtain a shard from charming '''Arachne''', which is affected by {{stat|hunting fortune}}. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/Jul 22|version=none|Changed '''Arachne''' [[Bestiary]] Tiers from {{Green|20}} to {{Green|15}}.}} {{History|2026/Aug 25|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|300-500}} to {{Level|87-143}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|2,000-8,000}} to {{Gold|217-357}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|15-20}} to {{Dark Aqua|261-429}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|200-400}} to {{Dark Aqua|652-1,072}}.}} |beta= {{History|0.11.2|[[File: Spider.png|26px]] Added '''Arachne'''.}} {{History|link=none|2022/Sep 16|Added {{Item|Luxurious Spool}} to loot table of Level 300 Arachne.}} {{History|2022/Nov 9|Revamped the boss fight|Reduced the HP of Level 300 Arachne from 1m to 20k, Reduced HP of Level 500 Arachne from 20m to 100k|Added [[Arachne's Fang]] and [[Arachne's Armor]] as possible drops.}} {{History|0.23|Added {{Item|Arachne Shard}} to the loot table.}} {{History|0.24.5|Fixed '''Arachne''' and {{MobSprite|Arachne's Brood}} being able to exit [[Arachne's Sanctuary]]}} {{History|0.27|version=none|Changed '''Arachne''' [[Bestiary]] Tiers from {{Green|20}} to {{Green|15}}.}} {{History|0.27.2|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|300-500}} to {{Level|87-143}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|2,000-8,000}} to {{Gold|217-357}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|15-20}} to {{Dark Aqua|261-429}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|200-400}} to {{Dark Aqua|652-1,072}}.}} }} [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Mobs]]

Subject of mockeries, even from his disciples. |mob_level = 430-982 |id = LIVID_1, LIVID_CLONE_1, MASTER_LIVID_1, MASTER_LIVID_CLONE_1 }} '''Livid''' is the {{mcat|b}} of [[The Catacombs - Floor V]]. == Collection == Killing Livid increases the Livid collection. {{CollectionTable|Livid}} {{/Collection UI}} == Boss Fight == === Overview === [[File:Thorn Orb.png|thumb|100px|The remains of Thorn]] Livid reveals a Dark Orb in the center of the arena as the remains of [[Thorn]] and that he is using its power to clone himself. After {{Green|16s}}, he blinds everyone for {{Green|1s}} and spawns eight clones from Endermen. Each of these clones has the same amount of health and stats, but they have different nametag colors. The real Livid can be identified by looking at the color of the ceiling once the clones have spawned. When players kill a clone, it will regenerate all the way back to full HP and heal nearby clones by 25% of their maximum health. There, he became a member when only 15 years old. He received his first assassination contract at the age of 17, directly from the Guild's leader. While Livid was a very skilled thief, this was going to be his first murder, and he enjoyed it, seeing it as art. Over the years, he started to think it was too easy for him, and sought more challenging kills. One night, he went to an [[Wilderness#Tavern|Inn]] to murder someone. Sitting at a table, he noticed [[Necron|a mysterious man]] come in, which was Necron before fully withering. Livid noticed that he hid a small chest in a long black cape. Very soon after Necron came in, Livid noticed [[The Watcher|another man]] was following him and studying Necron for almost an hour. This was Lathrop, the man that becomes the Watcher. After Necron suddenly left his table and went upstairs, Livid decided to learn more about him. He sat down with Lathrop, pretending to be drunk. He learned that Necron was "a merchant from far away." Livid decided that he would kill Necron as he was a "perfect target." Livid went to Necron's room from the outside and saw that he was sleeping, but there was no sign of the small chest. He readied [[Livid Dagger|his dagger]] to strike, when his concentration was halted by a sound coming from an already inspected empty corner. Livid knew that sound does not come from thin air, unless magic is involved. The body in the bed was gone, and Livid felt himself being cut in half with no time to react. This was Necron. The blade was pulled out, no blood flowed, and Livid couldn't feel his body anymore. His killer, [[Necron]], then took his body with him to [[The Catacombs]]. Necron quickly noticed he was followed by [[The Watcher|Lathrop]], after questioning him, Necron decided to take Lathrop with him to [[The Wither King|his Master]]. Livid then became a Master Necromancer, training disciples, presumably for Necron's army. However his subjects were not loyal to him and mock him. The reasons for this are currently unknown. == Trivia == *The Livid Clones each have references in them. **Vendetta Livid wears a Guy Fawkes Mask, a reference to Guy Fawkes in the Gunpowder Plot in §c[BOSS] Dante§f: §lPets have now been outlawed effective immediately. They were too distracting which is too dangerous to players.
§c[BOSS] Dante§f: §lThey also won't stop sniffing the goons...
§c[BOSS] Dante§f: §lUntil further notice, we have ended our alliance with the sketchy Dwarves and will be preventing players from going to their mines.
§c[BOSS] Dante§f: §lMining Islands have now been outlawed, effective immediately. We will be considering outlawing Mining in general too, but that's for another time. It's just too dangerous.
§c[BOSS] Dante§f: §lIsland Transportation has been outlawed. Nowhere is safer than home.
§c[BOSS] Dante§f: §lI am hearing rumblings of a resistance led by Technoblade. Anyone found to be assisting this futile attempt will be CRUSHED.
§c[BOSS] Dante§f: §lORDER
§c[BOSS] Dante§f: §lSECURITY
§c[BOSS] Dante§f: §lFREEDOM
§c[BOSS] Dante§f: §lJUSTICE
§c[BOSS] Dante§f: §lAuction House and Bazzar have now been outlawed. It is too dangerous to spend money in this day and age.
§c[BOSS] Dante§f: §lORDER. SECURITY AND FREEDOM
§c[BOSS] Dante§f: §lDo not sub to Technoblade. He is a dangerous individual.
§c[BOSS] Dante§f: §lLeaders of the Resistance, meet me in the COMMUNITY CENTER - it's time we settle this.
